title: Typer option and installed command compatibility
question: What changes on Typer 0.28.0 and do representative adapter contracts still hold?
method: Run the same fixtures and installed commands against both releases on CPython 3.14.10, then exercise independent just and Rich controls.
conclusion: Observed inferred option rename and bounded compatibility for explicit alias, callback order, completion, usage and docs. Separate controls establish literal argv and terminal-control rendering behavior.
